toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":6,"perceivedCorrectness":80,"actionability":6,"reason":"The brief is persuasive because it has a control group (Pelion is unaffected on the same Tessaly crews), a natural experiment (Brackwater counters vs Fennick kiosks on 14–16 Oct), and a mechanism that fits the evidence (more encode-desk diversions, so bags reach the lateral after it closes); it also flags what is still uncertain and gives a cheap, reversible test with a clear next step."}

output.reason: The brief is persuasive because it has a control group (Pelion is unaffected on the same Tessaly crews), a natural experiment (Brackwater counters vs Fennick kiosks on 14–16 Oct), and a mechanism that fits the evidence (more encode-desk diversions, so bags reach the lateral after it closes); it also flags what is still uncertain and gives a cheap, reversible test with a clear next step.
